name: shelves-loader
description: Standalone host/loader for Deck Shelves. pnpm is the single entry point: it installs the toolchain, builds and runs the Rust loader + devtools, drives the local debug harness, and deploys/debugs against a Steam Deck over SSH.

scripts.deck:inject: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cargo run --quiet --bin shelves-devtools -- --host "$DECK_CDP_HOST" --port "$DECK_CDP_PORT" inject --bundle bundle/index.js'
scripts.deck:reinject: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cargo run --quiet --bin shelves-devtools -- --host "$DECK_CDP_HOST" --port "$DECK_CDP_PORT" eval "delete window.__SHELVES_HOST__; delete window.__SHELVES_LOADER__"'
